findings.evidence: Lines 425–435 quantify over arbitrary complete real normed codomains and closed forms; the proof uses `homologyPeriodHom_loopClass` and `pathClassIntegral_mk_eq_pathIntegral`, with no logarithmic-derivative dependency.
findings.fix: Move and export this theorem in `DeRham/HomologyPeriod.lean`.
findings.issue: The private `pathIntegral_eq_homologyPeriodHom` hides the general bridge from smooth-loop integrals to singular homology periods, preventing reuse for other closed forms.

findings.evidence: Lines 272–274 prove smoothness of the complex coercion of any smooth circle-valued map solely by composing `contMDiff_coe_sphere` with `u.contMDiff`.
findings.fix: Relocate and export it in an appropriate manifold circle/sphere module.

summary: Reusable infrastructure is hidden as private helpers in the logarithmic-period development.
